surveyed.source: Bridge frame along bearing 69.1 deg from the OSM man_made=bridge outline (48.9 x 21.2 m) and the Gemeente Amsterdam register outline BRU0236 (pier notches at 16.1 and 32.8 m); deck kept 6 cm under the game's ride surface (scripts/landmarks/blauwbrug-footprints.json rideProfile, bridge-deck-probe.ts). Native X east, Z south, y = scene z; groundAltitudeMetres puts the pier feet (-2.4) on the runtime's anchor base (0.486). Faces read from the Gemeente Amsterdam boat panoramas TMX7316010203-000355_pano_0001_001567 and -000354_pano_0001_001572 (CC BY 4.0) and Wikimedia Commons photographs; Rijksmonument 518352 register text (three passages, ship-bow piers, eight red granite columns with sixteen lanterns and imperial crowns, white limestone vase balustrade).

throughPassages.evidence: Blauwbrug west side arch: one of the three navigable passages of the Amstel under the bridge (Rijksmonument 518352: 'drie doorvaarten'; boat panoramas TMX7316010203-000355_pano_0001_001567 and -000354_pano_0001_001572 look through it). Corridor = the opening along the bridge axis (bridge frame along -23.1..-9.85 m) across the whole deck width plus 4 m each side, in model-local east/south metres; the water runs at bearing 159.1/339.1.

Blauwbrug flat central span: one of the three navigable passages of the Amstel under the bridge (Rijksmonument 518352: 'drie doorvaarten'; boat panoramas TMX7316010203-000355_pano_0001_001567 and -000354_pano_0001_001572 look through it). Corridor = the opening along the bridge axis (bridge frame along -6.85..6.85 m) across the whole deck width plus 4 m each side, in model-local east/south metres; the water runs at bearing 159.1/339.1.

Blauwbrug east side arch: one of the three navigable passages of the Amstel under the bridge (Rijksmonument 518352: 'drie doorvaarten'; boat panoramas TMX7316010203-000355_pano_0001_001567 and -000354_pano_0001_001572 look through it). Corridor = the opening along the bridge axis (bridge frame along 9.85..23.1 m) across the whole deck width plus 4 m each side, in model-local east/south metres; the water runs at bearing 159.1/339.1.
